kebab_example: aliyun dbs create-download --region-code cn-beijing --instance-name rm-wz994c1t10000 --api-version 2021-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDownload

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html operation for an ApsaraDB RDS instance or the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319132.html operation for a PolarDB cluster to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319132.html查询
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.help_en:
The type of the download task. Valid values:

full: Downloads a full backup set.

pitr: Downloads data from a point in time
parameters.help_zh:
下载任务类型，取值如下：

full：全量备份集下载。
pitr：任意时间点下载
parameters.name: bak_set_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html operation for an ApsaraDB RDS instance or the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319224.html operation for a PolarDB cluster to obtain the backup set ID.

This parameter is required if `BakSetType` is set to `full`
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319224.html接口获取该参数值。

当BakSetType=full时，该参数必填
parameters.name: bak_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time for the download. Specify a Unix timestamp in milliseconds (ms).

This parameter is required if `BakSetType` is set to `pitr`
parameters.help_zh:
下载任意时间点。Long类型时间戳形式，单位为毫秒（ms）。

当BakSetType=pitr时，该参数必填
parameters.name: download_point_in_time

parameters.help_en: The size of the full backup set, in bytes. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html operation for an ApsaraDB RDS instance or the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319224.html operation for a PolarDB cluster to query the size
parameters.help_zh: 全量备份集大小，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319224.html接口查询，单位为字节（Byte）
parameters.name: bak_set_size

parameters.help_en:
The target format of the downloaded data. Valid values:

CSV

SQL

Parquet

Bson

qp.xb

This parameter is required. The `Bson` format is available only for MongoDB instances. The `qp.xb` format is available only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
下载转换的目标格式，取值如下：

CSV
SQL
Parquet
Bson
qp.xb

该参数为必填项。其中，Bson格式当且仅当实例类型为MongoDB时才能进行选择；qp.xb格式当且仅当实例类型为RDS MySQL时才能进行选择
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en:
The destination type for the download. Valid values:

OSS

URL
parameters.help_zh:
下载目标类型，取值如下：

OSS
URL
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination OSS bucket.

This parameter is required if `TargetType` is set to `OSS`.

Make sure that your account is granted the AliyunDBSDefaultRole role. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26307.html. You can also grant the role in the console by following the on-screen instructions
parameters.help_zh:
OSS Bucket名称。

当TargetType=OSS时，该参数必填。
请确认您的账号已拥有AliyunDBSDefaultRole权限，如何授权，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26307.html。您也可访问控制台根据操作指引去授权
parameters.name: target_bucket

parameters.help_en:
The destination path for the downloaded data.

This parameter is required if `TargetType` is set to `OSS`
parameters.help_zh:
数据下载目标路径。

当TargetType=OSS时，该参数必填
parameters.name: target_path

parameters.help_en:
The region where the destination OSS bucket is located.

This parameter is required if `TargetType` is set to `OSS`
parameters.help_zh:
OSS Bucket所在地域。

当TargetType=OSS时，该参数必填
parameters.name: target_oss_region

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for MongoDB instances. It specifies whether the primary key in a table is unique. Set the value to `true` if the primary key is unique, or `false` otherwise
parameters.help_zh:
仅MongoDB引擎需要填写该字段。用于标识库表中主键类型是否唯一。
是: true; 否: false
parameters.name: primary_key_type_only

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for MongoDB instances. Set the value to `true` if the instance is a sharded cluster, or `false` otherwise
parameters.help_zh:
仅MongoDB引擎需要填写该字段。用于标识当前实例是否为分片集群。
类型为MongoDB分片集群: true; 类型为其他: false
parameters.name: is_cluster

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for MongoDB instances. It specifies the name of the authentication database. The default value is `admin`
parameters.help_zh: 仅MongoDB引擎需要填写该字段。用于标识鉴权库名称。默认名称为admin
parameters.name: admin_database

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the zstd compression algorithm. Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 用于标识压缩包采纳的压缩算法是否为zstd。默认为false
parameters.name: use_zstd

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only for MongoDB sharded clusters. It specifies the ID of the sharded cluster
parameters.help_zh: 仅MongoDB引擎分片集群需要填写该字段。分片集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required only when you download data in the `qp.xb` format from an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance. In this case, set the value to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 仅当您的实例类型为RDS MySQL且需要下载qp.xb格式时，该参数才必填。您需要指定该参数为true
parameters.name: is_physical

Data.description_en: The details of the download task

BackupSetTime.description_en: The point-in-time of the backup set, returned as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
BackupSetTime.description_zh: 任意时间点下载任务时所对应的时间点，返回格式为时间戳形式

BakSetId.description_en: The ID of the full backup set

DbList.description_en: If the download is for specific databases or tables, this parameter lists their names
DbList.description_zh: 当下载任务为库表过滤任务时，该字段返回对应库表信息

DownloadStatus.description_en:
The status of the download task. Valid values:

initializing: The task is initializing.

queueing: The task is queued.

running: The task is running.

failed: The task failed.

finished: The task is complete.

expired: The task has expired.

If the download destination is a URL, the link expires three days after the task completes
DownloadStatus.description_zh:
下载任务的状态，返回值如下：

initializing：初始化。
queueing：排队中。
running：下载中。
failed：下载失败。
finished：下载成功。
expired：下载过期。

下载目标为URL的任务完成3天后会过期

ExportDataSize.description_en: The size of the exported data, in bytes
ExportDataSize.description_zh: 导出数据量，单位为字节（Byte）

Format.description_en: The format to which the data is converted

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the task, returned as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 任务创建时间，返回格式为时间戳形式

ImportDataSize.description_en: The size of the processed data, in bytes
ImportDataSize.description_zh: 处理数据量，单位为字节（Byte）

Progress.description_en:
The number of tables downloaded versus the total number of tables.

If the task is initializing, `0/0` is returned
Progress.description_zh:
已下载表数量/表总数。

如果任务当前处理准备阶段，该进度返回为0/0

TargetPath.description_en:
The destination path for the data download.

This parameter is returned only when `TargetType` is `OSS`
TargetPath.description_zh:
数据下载目标路径。

当TargetType=OSS时，该参数返回

TargetType.description_en: The destination type for the download

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the download task

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
